extension.summary: MegaNexus Hub: the backend and the complete MegaNexus installer.
extension.description: Backend for the MegaNexus interface and skin. Metadata add-ons supply catalog metadata; individually enabled stream add-ons supply sources in their original order. Includes local component installation, account sync, Continue Watching and playback services. Manual bundle ZIP updates only.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any of the content which is found and has no affiliation with any of the content providers. The author is in no way affiliated with Kodi, Team Kodi, or the XBMC Foundation.
extension.news: MegaNexus 9.0.1 - tracking made right. - Same watch history everywhere: Trakt, Simkl, MDBList and WeTrakr get only what each is missing, with the date it was watched; nothing is removed or counted twice (Accounts & tracking). - Continue Watching: a finished title comes back only when it is really watched again; real dates, never the time of an import. - Trakt: every page of your history is read; sign-ins stay; paused episodes kept the same as here. - Anime numbered the same on every service. - WeTrakr without an own app: just Connect; start, pause and stop are reported. - The subtitle list fills while the add-ons answer, languages by full name. - Trailers start at once; Home never waits for them. - A new Artwork choice switches every picture at once; old pictures cleaned every week.

extension.summary: MegaNexus image or animation, custom image/GIF or looping silent video screensaver.
extension.description: Shows the MegaNexus logo, still or animated by the skin (no video player), or use custom artwork or a local/shared MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and other supported video file. Video mode preserves paused media by falling back to artwork. Follows the shared weather and clock visibility preference.
Installs and updates the MegaNexus build (MegaNexus Hub, the MegaNexus interface, MegaNexus Skin and MegaNexus Screensaver) from GitHub Pages. Kodi checks this repository for updates automatically.
